R2 requires 'ボード/gh が利用不可（loadBoardConfig 失敗等）の場合は ok=true の非致命的な skipped 結果を返し flow を止めない' with no requirement to log the caught loadBoardConfig failure — the error is discarded without being logged or re-thrown.
R3 requires 'ボード/gh 利用不可、または対象エントリが無い場合は ok=true の空/skipped 結果を返し flow を止めない' with no logging requirement for the caught error, specifying silent discard of the underlying failure.

AC5 states 'issue-start・issue-log-import は非致命的な結果を返して flow を止めず' on board/gh unavailability without requiring the underlying error to be logged or re-thrown, echoing the silent-swallow behavior as an acceptance criterion.
T-3 acceptance item 'ボード/gh 利用不可または対象0件で ok=true の空/skipped を返し flow を止めない' requires catching board/gh errors and returning ok=true with no logging requirement, specifying silent error discarding.

R3 requires loading '全エントリを追加候補として JSON envelope で出力する' from issue-log.json with no stated upper bound on entry count or file size. No bounded-resource-usage acknowledgment is present in the spec's constraints, clarifications, or alternatives_considered.
T-3 acceptance item 'issue-log.json の全エントリが候補として JSON envelope で出力される' requires unbounded full-file loading with no maximum entry count or size limit stated.

R2 introduces the issue-start <issueNumber> subcommand but does not list validation requirements for the issueNumber argument — no type (integer vs string), format (e.g., positive integer), or range is specified.

R3 introduces the issue-log-import --spec <path> subcommand but does not list validation requirements for the --spec path argument — no type (file path), format constraints (e.g., must be an existing readable path ending in issue-log.json), or range is specified.
